items.title: Why Is My Kubernetes Job Still Pending? Tracing Kueue Admission with Headlamp
items.blurb: You submit a Kubernetes Job and wait for its Pods to appear. A minute passes. Then another. The Job is still suspended, there are no application logs, and there may not even be a Pod to inspect.

items.blurb: In Linux, cgroups (control groups) are a kernel feature used for managing system resources.

items.title: Scaling Kubernetes Workloads with Node Swap
items.blurb: Memory is often the first hard limit a Kubernetes cluster hits. Nodes run out of RAM long before they run out of CPU, and the new wave of agentic AI workloads makes this worse.
